FOREWORD
This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards. after the draft finalized by the Pesticides Sectional Committee had been approved by the Food and Agriculture Division Council. Fluvalinate EC is generally used in the control of insect pests in agriculture. Fluvalinate EC is generally formulated to contain 25 percent ( mjm) of fluvahnate. In the preparation of this standard, due consideration has been given to the requirements of tbe Insecticides Act, /968 and the Rules framed thereunder. However, this standard is subject to tbe restrictions imposed under these wherever applicable. For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of tbis standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the re: ult of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 'Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised)'. The number of sicnificant places retained in this rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

3.2.2 Cold Test
No turbidity or separation of solid or oily matter or both shall occur when the material is subjected to the cold test at 100e as prescribed in 13.1 of IS 6940 : 191Q or at any other lower temperature as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. Introduction of a seedling crystal is not necessary for the test.

When tested by the method prescribed in 11.3 of IS 6940 : 1982, the acidity (as H~SOJ) shall not be more than 0�50 percent by mass.
4 PACKING

The material shall be packed 111 aluminium con tainers ( see IS 9445 : 1980, IS 9503 : 1988 and IS 12340: 1988). In addition, the material shall comply with general requirements as given in IS 8190 ( Part 2) : 1988.
5 MARKING

3.2.3 Flash Point ( Abel)

When determined by the method prescribed in IS 1448 ( P : 20 ) : 1982, the flash point of the material shall be above 24'5 C.
3.2.4 Emulsion Stability

Any separation including creaming at the top and sedimentation at the bottom of 100 ml of emulsion prepared in standard hard water with 2�0 ml of concentrate, shall not exceed 2"0 ml when tested by the method prescribed in 3.2.1 to 3.2.4 and 3.3.1.

3.1.5 Heat Stability
After treating in accordance with the method prescribed in 13.4 of IS 6940 : 1982, the material shall comply with the requirements specified in 3.2.1 to 3.2.4 and 3.3.1.

The container shall bear legibly and indelibly the following information anti any other inforrn.uron as is necessary under the Insecticides .Icr, 1965 and Rules: a) Name of tile material, b) Indication of the source of manufacture; c) Batch number; d) Date of manufacture and date of expiry; e) Net mass; f) Nominal fluvalinate content, percent (1/1,'111); and g) A cautionary notice as worded in Insecticides Act, /968 and Rule".
6 SAMPLING

Representative samples of the material shall be drawn as prescribed in IS 10627 : 1983.
